> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `init: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance init [path] [flags]
```

Scaffold a new project in path (default: the current directory): the folder structure and starter files — `schema/`, `rules/`, `templates/`, entity-type folders, `.component` and plugins.lock — from the default or a named starter template.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--template name` | — | starter template name (default: the built-in default template) |
